corpus.scope: every paragraph of every article in a batch whose root is NewsRegistry.isTrustedRoot at question time; identical paragraph texts are indexed once (first article in batch order)
corpus.scope_hash: sha256(concat(sorted unique batch roots)), bound into the committed request

fusion.order: score quantised to 1e-9 desc, then leaf index

relevance.rule: a candidate is relevant if query-token coverage >= min_coverage AND dense cosine >= min_cosine; coverage = |distinct BM25 query tokens present in paragraph| / |distinct BM25 query tokens|

selection.rule: first prompt_k relevant candidates in rank order; none relevant -> 'Not found in registered news.' without a model call

cutoff.as_of: max block timestamp over the scope batches (on-chain)
cutoff.rule: explicit dates after as_of (year, month+year, month+day), or 'tomorrow' / 'next week|month|year' -> abstain without a model call
